verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Incident Response Management (IRM) product explicitly supports on-call schedules, alert escalation, and incident coordination from declaration through post-incident review, with investigation using linked metrics/logs/traces during an incident (timelines). Community evidence corroborates that incident management is a real, priced offering alongside metrics/logs/alerts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the full timeline/escalation UX and deeper detail on post-incident review workflow beyond the doc summary.
